offering_description.value: Manufactures, packages and distributes Coca-Cola branded and other nonalcoholic beverages under franchise agreements. Sells to retailers, restaurants and other outlets, delivering through its own warehouses and fleet. Also provides manufacturing and distribution to other Coca-Cola bottlers.

primary_products.value: sparkling soft drinks; bottled water; sports and energy drinks; tea and coffee beverages; juice drinks

primary_services.value: beverage distribution and delivery; contract packaging for other bottlers; vending and merchandising support

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery and convenience stores, mass merchants, restaurants, vending operators, other Coca-Cola bottlers

end_markets.value: retail grocery; convenience stores; foodservice and restaurants; vending; consumer beverages

revenue_model.value: product sales: bottled and canned beverages sold to retail and foodservice customers; service fees: manufacturing and distribution fees from other bottlers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: mixes concentrate with sweeteners and packaging to produce beverages, sold to retailers and restaurants; distributor: warehouses and delivers beverages to customer locations

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern and Mid-Atlantic US states, including North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, Tennessee, Alabama, West Virginia

specialization.value: related lines: carbonated drinks, water, energy, sports and tea beverages, plus contract manufacturing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct store delivery to grocery, convenience and mass merchant stores; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors and wholesalers for some outlets; other: vending and fountain accounts, national account programs

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food and beverage safety (FDA), environmental, fleet transport, and labeling rules, franchise agreements with The Coca-Cola Company
